BiblicalUsage: Arab is named once, as a town in the hill country of Judah, listed beside Dumah and Eshean in the inheritance of the tribe. It is a place on the map of Judah's allotment, nothing more and nothing less.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every town in Judah's inheritance matters, because the promise was measured out town by town, and God keeps the whole map.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
